description: Get headline registration numbers from the active ticketing rail: orders, paid orders, gross takings, valid tickets, and check-ins. Use it for a quick count; use get_ticketing_overview for refunds, ticket types against capacity, and the waitlist. Returns configured (false when no rail is set up), provider, currency, counts, and grossCents.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: get_registration_stats

capped.description: True when counting stopped at its cap.

configured.description: False when no ticketing rail is active; no other fields follow.

grossCents.description: Gross paid takings in minor units of currency.
